at://did:plc:su47cn47fh3e5n6zcchnyws5/ap.text: I’m exploring an interesting possibility in DOS gaming on AGP/PCI-era VGA cards: Bus-master DMA transfers of system RAM to video RAM. at://did:plc:jzq6wvramcauiwnxdwjg32bo/ap.name: solavattam
at://did:plc:jzq6wvramcauiwnxdwjg32bo/ap.text: I’m a few of hours into the Zelda OoT remake and I’m impressed with the balance they struck between staying true to the original and where they made changes. Even the cutscenes, which didn’t have super high expectations for initially, feel both nostalgic and at time are very moving. What a game.
